name: alert-dialog-09
description: Confirmation for taking a live website offline.

files.content:
import { CloudOffIcon, GlobeIcon } from "lucide-react"

import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogMedia,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from "@workspace/ui/components/alert-dialog"
import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button"

export default function UnpublishSiteDialog() {
  return (
    <AlertDialog>
      <AlertDialogTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>
        <GlobeIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
        Unpublish site
      </AlertDialogTrigger>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogMedia>
            <CloudOffIcon />
          </AlertDialogMedia>
          <AlertDialogTitle>Take maple-bakery.site offline?</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            Visitors will see a placeholder page until you publish again. Your
            content and settings are kept.
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction variant="destructive">Unpublish</AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  )
}
